definitions.explanation: The first star visible in the evening sky, typically Venus when it appears as the evening star.

examples.japanese: {一番星|いちばんぼし}が{見|み}えた。
examples.english: I saw the first star (of the evening).

examples.japanese: {一番星|いちばんぼし}に{願|ねが}いをかける。
examples.english: I make a wish upon the first star.

examples.japanese: {日|ひ}が{暮|く}れて{一番星|いちばんぼし}が{輝|かがや}き{始|はじ}めた。
examples.english: The sun set and the first star began to shine.

notes:
{一番星|いちばんぼし} is a poetic term for the first star visible at dusk.

ASTRONOMY:
The {一番星|いちばんぼし} is usually {金星|きんせい} (Venus) when it appears as the {宵|よい}の{明星|みょうじょう} (evening star).

CULTURAL NOTE:
In Japanese folklore, making a wish upon the first star is similar to the Western "wish upon a star" tradition. The phrase 「{一番星|いちばんぼし}{見|み}つけた」 (I found the first star) is often said by children excited to spot it.

RELATED WORDS:
- {宵|よい}の{明星|みょうじょう}: evening star (Venus)
- {明|あ}けの{明星|みょうじょう}: morning star (Venus)
